configuration.workload_description: Deterministic 500-round batch-overhead workload restoring empty-edge topology
configuration.warmup: 50 query-only batch operations prior to measurement window
configuration.connection_model: HTTP/1.1 sequential loopback TCP (Connection: close; full round-trip per batch)

units.duration_ns: Raw integer nanoseconds as measured by std::time::Instant
units.request_latency_ns: Raw integer nanoseconds per HTTP batch request round-trip (connect + send + recv + close)
units.request_latency_us: Floating-point microseconds per HTTP batch request (latency_ns / 1,000.0)
units.elapsed_window_ns_per_logical_op: Amortized elapsed window nanoseconds per logical operation (window_duration_ns / total_logical_operations). Note: Aggregate elapsed-window metrics explicitly include client request serialization, network transit, response deserialization, item-level correctness validation, revision arithmetic checks, and bookkeeping; they are distinct from individual request latency and pure server-side execution time.
units.logical_ops_per_sec: Logical operations per second over the aggregate measurement window (total_logical_operations / window_duration_s). Measures end-to-end client dispatch throughput including serialization, response validation, and bookkeeping; distinct from server-side execution time.
units.requests_per_sec: HTTP batch requests per second over timed measurement window (actual_requests / window_duration_s)

notes.latency_concept: Request latency measures pure loopback HTTP round-trip (connect + send request + receive response body + close connection) per batch request. It reflects network and server batch handling time. Never divide request latency by batch size to fabricate individual-operation latency.
notes.window_concept: Elapsed window duration measures aggregate end-to-end benchmark time across the entire 2,000-operation trace, explicitly including client request serialization, network transit, response parsing, per-item correctness validation, revision arithmetic checks, and bookkeeping. These aggregate elapsed-window metrics must be distinguished from individual request latency and pure server-side execution time.

memory.note: Sampled at 25ms intervals via ps; not guaranteed absolute peak RSS
